topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe it! All this time we've been talking, sharing so much, and it turns out they're practically on my doorstep. We could have met, had real conversations, shared actual moments. Instead, it's been texts and calls, when all along we could have been doing so much more. Now I'm not sure what to think. Do I reach out and suggest we finally meet in person? Or do I just let it go, disappointed in the lost opportunity? It feels like a trick, like they've been keeping something major from me. I don't know if I can look at our conversations the same way now.
